name: Hurtworld
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A hardcore multiplayer survival shooter. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with Oxide for plugins if you want it.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./Hurtworld.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -exec "host {{SERVER_PORT}};queryport {{QUERY_PORT}};maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}};servername {{HOSTNAME}};creativemode {{CREATIVE_MODE}}${ADMINS:+;addadmin $ADMINS}" -logfile

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Hurtworld. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 405100) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and Oxide when asked. Saves, configs
# and plugins are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-405100}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Hurtworld looks for Steam's client library next to its own plugins.
mkdir -p Hurtworld_Data/Plugins/x86 Hurtworld_Data/Plugins/x86_64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so Hurtworld_Data/Plugins/x86/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so Hurtworld_Data/Plugins/x86_64/

# Oxide (uMod), the plugin framework, when asked: it replaces some of the
# game's files, so turning it off puts those back. Plugins stay in oxide/.
extra=""
if [ "${INSTALL_OXIDE:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    repo=OxideMod/Oxide.Hurtworld
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now to download Oxide. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ "$(cat .raptor-oxide 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
        echo "Oxide $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading Oxide $tag"
        work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
        rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
        trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
        gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" Oxide.Hurtworld-linux.zip "$work/oxide.zip" || fail "The Oxide download failed. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -tq "$work/oxide.zip" >/dev/null || fail "The Oxide download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
        unzip -qo "$work/oxide.zip" -d .
        echo "$tag" > .raptor-oxide
    fi
    mkdir -p oxide/plugins
    extra=" with Oxide $tag"
elif [ -f .raptor-oxide ]; then
    echo "Putting the game's own files back, as Oxide is off."
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log || fail "SteamCMD couldn't put the game's own files back. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -f .raptor-oxide
fi
echo "Installed Hurtworld build ${build:-unknown}${extra}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Owner's Steam ID
variables.description: The 17-digit Steam ID of a player to make an admin, or empty for none.

variables.name: Creative mode
variables.description: Free building, with no need to gather.

variables.name: Oxide
variables.description: Install Oxide (uMod) for plugins; put them in oxide/plugins. Reinstall after changing it, and after the game updates.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
